tei:div.tei:p: (465)'phags pa sgrub pa'i brgyud 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ oṃ ārya tā re ye/ srid zhi kun khyab rnam kun stong pa nyid/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ shes rab phar phyin chos sku yum chen mo/ rje btsun 'phags ma yum la gsol ba 'debs/ bde stong zug ngag ye shes sgyu ma'i sku/ nges pa lnga ldan sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs/ dbyings kyi rang bzhin rigs kyi ḍākki lnga/ je btsun 'phags ma yum la= rnam dag padma drwa ba'i zhing khams su/ sangs rgyas ma chags padma'i spyan mnga' ba/ yid can mtha' dag bde bar dbugs 'byin mdzad/ rje btsun 'phags ma= gdul (466)bya'i khams dang dbang po'i bye brag gis/ gang 'dul cir yang 'char ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ rnam rol sprul pa'i lha mo myur dpa' mo/ dbyangs can bsod nams mchog ster gtsug tor rgyal/ ku ru kulle 'jigs byed chen mo dang*/ gtum mo mi thub gzhan mi rgyal ma dang*/ khams gsum rnam rgyal nor ster dbang byed ma/ bkra shis don byed lha mo dgra dpung 'joms/ khro gnyer can dang rab zhi 'bar ba'i 'od/ dpag med gnon ma rma bya chen mo dang*/ mi pham rgyal mo ri khrod lo gyon ma/ 'od zer can ma rnams la/ gangs can ljongs 'dir bstan pa rin po che/ thog mar gsal ba'i sgo chen rab phye ba/ ārya tā re rgya rje'i sras mo'i tshul/ rje btsun lha cig kong jo la (467)gsol ba 'debs/ skye dang skye bar 'phags mas rjes bzungs shing*/ byang chub spyod pa rgya mtshor dbang 'byor bas/ 'phags pa dgyes pa'i lam bzang gsal byed pa/ rgyal sras padma las 'brel la= de ltar snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ byang chub sems 'byongs dag snang lha skugs dag bskyed rdzogs don la rang byan tshud pa dang*/ yang dag lam gyi 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen smon pa yin bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ mi dge sdig pa ma lus kun dag nas/

gzhan gyis sdang dang rmi lam ngan pa bral/ ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyob par byin gyis rlobs/ mi khom brgyad du nam yang mi skye zhing*/ rtag tu skye ba dran dang dbang po gsal/ tshul khrims rnam (468)dag chos la yid gzhungs nas/ stobs dang gzi byin phun sum tshogs par mdzod/ ma rung dgra dang gdon bgegs 'tshe ba dang*/ dus min 'chi dang rims dang dug gi nad/ nyon mongs las kyi rnam par smin pa las/ bsrung dang skyob dang sbod par byin gyis rlobs/ tshe dang longs spyod stobs dang bkrag mdangs ldan/ rtag tu 'phags ma'i zhal mthong byin gyis brlab/ thugs rjes gzhan don ris med phrin las kyi/ 'khor lo gsum gyis nyin mtshan 'da' ba dang*/ mthar thug rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob nas/ mtha' yas 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor bdag 'gyur zhing*/ rje btsun khyed dang dgongs spyod mnyam par shog
ces pa'ang sgrub brtson bla ma dam pa dpal ldan gyi bzhed skong du padma las 'brel gyis so/// /
